newsitem.title: USA: INCSTAR says sales of some tests eroding.
newsitem.headline: INCSTAR says sales of some tests eroding.

text.p: INCSTAR Corp said it continues to experience sales erosion in certain radioimmunoassay products, which which use small amounts of radioactive materials to measure diagnostic results.

Chief executive John Booth said, "While we are continuing to experience sales erosion in some of our radioimmunoassay products, we are steadfast in our goal to grow the business through the development of innovative diagnostic products.
The medical tests maker reported third-quarter earnings of $0.06 per share, down from $0.07 per share a year ago.
